tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la bstod pa bzhugs// ༄༅// bsrung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs kyi bstod pa zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo// rang bzhin dag pa nyid las byung*// rdo rje sems dpa'i bdag nyid mchog /dung dang kun+da'i mdog dang mtshungs// so sor 'brang mar phyag 'tshal bstod// kha dog nag mo mi bzad 'jigs// rngam zhing zhal 'gyur khro bag can// gdul dka'i 'byung po yang dag 'dul// rdo rje khro mor phyag 'tshal bstod// lha mo ye shes las byung che// gser gyi 'od ltar rab 'bar ba'i// rma bya che la rab dad pas// rig pa'i rgyal mor phyag 'tshal bstod// pad+ma kha bye'i zhal mnga' ma// zhal mdzes ma la spyan yangs shing*// pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba'i// 'go ba'i mar gyur phyag 'tshal bstod// mthing kha mdzes pa'i 'od dang mtshungs// 'dod pa'i 'dod chags kyis sgeg ma// dug rnams 'joms par byed pa mo// sku mdzes ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// phyogs skyong rnams la bstod pa ni// gzi brjid ldan zhing dpal dang ldan// sde chen stobs kyang che ba ste// kun nas rang phyogs legs skyong ba'i// phyogs skyong rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// glang chen sa srung bu la ni// rol pas bzhugs pa'i gser mdog can// rdo rje 'chang ba lha yi rje// brgya byin la yang phyag 'tshal lo// rnam par bsgyings pa'i ma he la// mnyam par gnas pa añja'i mdog /be con 'chang ba ma mo'i rje// gshin rje la yang phyag 'tshal lo// chu srin la gnas chu shel mdog /nor bu dang bcas gdengs kas brgyan// sbrul zhags 'dzin pa klu yi rje// chu yi lha la phyag 'tshal lo// rta mchog zhon pa gser mdog can// nor bus mtshan pa'i dbyug to dang*// ne'u le 'dzin pa gnod sbyin rje// lus ngan po la phyag 'tshal lo// khyu mchog la gnas 'jigs chen po// phyugs bdag chen po kun+da'i mdog

/rtse gsum 'chang ba 'byung po'i rje// dbang ldan la yang phyag 'tshal lo// ra skyes zhon cing ches dmar ba// mchog sbyin dbyu gu bgrang phreng dang*// gun+de 'dzin pa drang srong rje// me yi lha la phyag 'tshal lo// gad rgyangs sgrogs pa'i ro langs la// brtan par gnas pa char sprin mdog /ral gri 'chang ba srin po'i rje// bden bral la yang phyag 'tshal lo// shin tu rtsen pa'i ri dwags kyi// bzhon pa la gnas margad mdog /ba dan 'dzin pa rig 'dzin rje// rlung gi lha la phyag 'tshal lo// ngang pa'i rgyal po la gnas pa// gser mdog gdong bzhi pad+ma dang*// bgrang phreng gun+de glegs bam 'dzin// skye dgu'i mes po la phyag 'tshal// phag la zhon cing brtan par gnas// shin tu 'bar ba'i gser mdog can// bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin// skye dgu'i ma la phyag 'tshal lo// de nas gza' dang rgyu skar rnams la bstod pa ni/ rgyu skar khrod na legs rgyu zhing*// skye dgu 'grib dang 'phel ba dang*// bde sdug legs nyes ston mdzad pa'i// gza' chen rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// li khri'i mdog mtshungs rab mdzes shing*// shing rta'i dkyil na nyi dkyil bzhugs// pad+ma dmar po'i sdong bu 'dzin// gzi brjid mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal// kun+da ltar dkar zla ba ni// bsil zer byed pa'i dbus na bzhugs// ku mu ta yi sdong bu 'dzin// zhi mdzad de la phyag 'tshal lo// mig dmar pad+ma rā ga'i mdog /ra skyes zhon zhing khro tshul can// gri gug dang ni mi mgo 'dzin// mthu chen de la phyag 'tshal lo// gza' lhag margad ltar ljang zhing*// pad+ma la gnas zhi ba'i sku// mdzes shing rab sgeg mda' gzhu 'dzin// bde mdzad de la phyag 'tshal lo// drang srong phur bu gser mdog can// glang chen steng na rol pas bzhugs// bgrang phreng ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin// thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal lo// pa sangs gangs ri'i mdog mtshungs pa// pad+ma la gnas bzhad pa'i zhal// shel phreng dang ni ril ba 'dzin// phan mdzad de la phyag 'tshal lo// span pa mig sman ltar gnag cing*// lto 'phye la zhon 'jigs pa'i gzugs// phreng ba dang ni dbyu gu 'dzin// mthu chen de la phyag 'tshal lo// lha min dbang po sgra gcan ni// sku mdog dmar nag 'jigs chen po// phyag gnyis nyi ma zla ba 'dzin// stobs chen de la phyag 'tshal lo// tog ni brag ri'i gdan la bzhugs// kha dog skya bsangs drag po'i gzugs// sbrul zhags dang ni ral gri 'dzin// gtum chen de la phyag 'tshal lo// sngon gyi legs spyad las grub cing*// mthu dang rdzu 'phrul mtha' yas pa// rang rang phyogs dang dus skyong ba'i// rgyu skar rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// gang dag shar gyi phyogs gnas pa'i// smin drug dang ni snar ma dang*// mgo lag nam so rgyal skag la// mchod cing bstod de phyag 'tshal lo// lho yi phyogs na 'khod pa yi// mchu dang gre dbo me bzhi dang*// nag pa sa ri sa ga la// mchod cing bstod de phyag 'tshal lo// gang dag nub kyi phyogs gnas pa'i// lha mtshams snron snrubs chu stod dang*// chu smad byi bzhin gro bzhin la// mchod cing bstod de phyag 'tshal lo// byang phyogs gnas pa'i mon gre dang*// mon gru khrums stod khrums smad dang*// nam gru tha skar bra nye la// mchod cing bstod de phyag 'tshal lo// de nas rgyal po chen po bzhi la bstod pa ni/

rgyal po chen po grags dang ldan// phyogs bzhi skyong zhing dgra rnams 'joms// sde dang rdzu 'phrul stobs che ba'i// rgyal chen bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal po chen po dpal ldan pa// margad mdog mtshungs pi wang 'dzin// dri za rnams la dbang mdzad pa// yul 'khor srung la phyag 'tshal lo// dpa' bo chen po stobs po che// kha dog sngon po ral gri 'dzin// grul bum rnams la dbang sgyur ba// 'phags skyes po la phyag 'tshal lo// mnga' bdag chen po mthu bo che// kha dog dmar ser sbrul zhags 'dzin// klu yi tshogs la mnga' mdzad pa// mig mi bzang la phyag 'tshal lo// sde dpon chen po gser mdog can// be con dang ni ne'u le 'dzin// gnod sbyin rnams la dbang sgyur ba// rnam thos sras la phyag 'tshal lo// //lha mo lnga'i bstod pa ni/ slob dpon shān+ti pas mdzad pa'i bsrung ba'i cho ga na bzhugs la/ lhag ma ni 'phags pas sbyar ba'o// 'jig rten pa'i bstod pa dang bcas pa ste bzhi pa'o// //oṃ kārti kā/ ro hi ṇi/ mṛ ga shi raḥ ardar/ pu narba su/ pu ṣ+ya/ ash+le ṣā/ maghā/ pūrba phalgu ṇi/ ut+ta ra phalgu ṇi/ hastā/ tsi trā/ swa sti/ bi shā khā/ a nu rā dha/ dz+ye ṣ+ṭha mū la pūrba ṣa ḍha/ ut+ta ra ṣa ḍha/ shra ba ṇā/ a bhi dzi ta/ dha niṣ+ṭhaḥ sha tā bhī ṣa/ pūrba bha dra pa dā/ urta ra bha dra ba dā/ re wa tī/ a swi ni/ bha ra ṇī/ ming gi tshig 'di dag gi thog mar oṃ dang*/ mthar swā hā sbyar bas/ sngags kyi tshig tu 'gyur ro// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
